Firecrawl is a web data API for AI developers. It converts websites and search results into clean Markdown or structured data for LLM applications and agents. Its listed founders are Caleb Peffer (co-founder and CEO), Eric Ciarla (co-founder), and Nicolas Silberstein Camara (co-founder and CTO). Peffer previously co-founded Mendable, an earlier document-chat product.

- **Product:** One profile describes a product that lets users search, scrape, parse, and interact with the web at scale, outputting clean Markdown or structured data for AI agents. Another lists scrape, search, crawl, extract, and map endpoints.
- **Founders:** Peffer is the co-founder and CEO of Firecrawl, an artificial intelligence data infrastructure platform based in San Francisco. The founder roster appears in Caleb Peffer, Co-founder and CEO; Eric Ciarla, Founder; Nicolas Silberstein Camara, Founder and CTO.
- **Origins:** Y Combinator lists the company as a Summer 2022 batch member. Firecrawl's own job posting says the team previously built Mendable, one of the first commercially available "chat with your data" applications.
- **Funding (sources conflict):** SeedTable and others report a $14.5M Series A on 19 August 2025. Dealroom instead reports that a $75 million Series B led by Smash Capital was raised in September 2026. I could not verify the Series B from a second source, so treat it with caution.


REMINDER: You MUST include the sources above in your response to the user using markdown hyperlinks.

content.text:
**What Firecrawl does:** Firecrawl is a web data API for AI developers. It turns websites and search results into clean Markdown or structured data that LLM applications and agents can use. Its endpoints include scrape, search, crawl, extract, and map.

**Founders:**
- Caleb Peffer, co-founder and CEO
- Eric Ciarla, co-founder
- Nicolas Silberstein Camara, co-founder and CTO

**Background:** The company is based in San Francisco and was in Y Combinator's Summer 2022 batch. The founders previously built Mendable, an early "chat with your data" product.

**Funding:** The sources disagree. Several report a $14.5M Series A on 19 August 2025. Dealroom alone reports a $75M Series B led by Smash Capital in September 2026. I couldn't confirm the Series B from a second source, so treat it with caution.

Sources:
- [Founding Fullstack Engineer at Firecrawl (S22)](https://workatastartup.com/jobs/64707)
- [Caleb Peffer – TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/author/caleb-peffer)
- [Firecrawl funding – Seedtable](https://seedtable.com/companies/firecrawl)
- [Firecrawl – Dealroom](https://dealroom.co/companies/firecrawl/)
- [Caleb Peffer – StartupIntros](https://startupintros.com/people/caleb-peffer)
